page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates modest processing capabilities. The single-core and multi-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng falls into the bottom 25%, while the PassMark CPU score and extended instructions test place the instance in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show a split profile, with small-block cached reads performing in the bottom 25%, whereas large-block uncached read and write operations reach average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks show lower efficiency, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10% and PassMark encryption tests in the bottom 25%.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio, this instance offers a stable environment for workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local storage. It is appropriate for moderate general-purpose tasks, basic web serving, and small-scale LLM inference using lightweight models, where prompt processing and text generation achieve average tier speeds. However, it is less effective for intensive database operations, high-throughput Redis deployments, or medium-to-large language model inference due to weaker performance in those specific benchmarks.
